name: Disable Windows Update Peer-to-Peer Sharing
description: Disables peer-to-peer sharing for Windows Update and Delivery Optimization while keeping normal Microsoft updates available. This reduces background upload traffic to other PCs on your network, which can improve internet speed during gaming or streaming.

description_i18n.en: Disables peer-to-peer sharing for Windows Update and Delivery Optimization while keeping normal Microsoft updates available. This reduces background upload traffic to other PCs on your network, which can improve internet speed during gaming or streaming.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert das Peer-to-Peer-Sharing für Windows-Updates und die Lieferoptimierung, während normale Updates weiterhin verfügbar bleiben. Dies reduziert den Hintergrund-Upload-Traffic zu anderen Computern im Netzwerk und kann Internetgeschwindigkeit beim Spielen oder Streaming verbessern.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le partage pair-à-pair pour les mises à jour Windows et l'optimisation de livraison tout en conservant les mises à jour Microsoft normales. Cela réduit le trafic d'envoi vers d'autres PC sur votre réseau, ce qui peut améliorer la vitesse Internet pendant le jeu ou le streaming.

warnings.title: Network traffic impact
warnings.message: On networks with multiple PCs, disabling P2P can increase total internet download usage because devices no longer share update content locally. Updates may still use bandwidth to download from Microsoft servers

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Sets the Delivery Optimization policy value DODownloadMode to 0 under HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization This disables peer-to-peer usage while keeping downloads available through Microsoft/HTTP sources
